items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: George Gaino says he was great. George Gaino plays very, very... similar to the style that Caffrey played

ctx.x: That's right, Caffrey Dierensburg. I don't know about him, yeah.
He was from Texas. He lived in Texas in the later years. George Gaino says he was great.
